text_block_list.text: During our training meeting, Biwa Hayahide gives out a sudden exclamation.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: What?! Objection! The defendant's explanation is—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: …Ahem. Excuse me. Please continue as you were.
choice_data_list: What kind of dream were you having?
What kind of dream were you having?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Um… You know that courtroom TV drama everyone's been talking about? It was about that…

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Please, don't ask me any more. I'm already embarrassed about that little outburst…
However, another "Objection!" rings out ten minutes later. It seems like Biwa Hayahide's not getting enough sleep.
